name: distinct_values
description: Return the distinct values of one field (up to 50, most frequent first, with counts), optionally within a filter. Call it before filtering or grouping on a text field, to use values that really exist (exact spelling and case) - a filter on a value that does not exist silently returns nothing.

collection.description: A data collection of the bank database (see the data dictionary), e.g. holdings.

field.description: Field name, e.g. stage or lob.
